channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Taylor Swift once said women in pop are discarded in their 30s. Now she's 36 and bigger than ever.
item.description: In her new docuseries, "The End of an Era," 36-year-old Taylor Swift says she feels "very depressed" about pop culture's obsession with youth.

item.title: I flew to the 'least touristy' island in Hawaii. I'd only suggest this wild trip to certain travelers.
item.description: My flight from Maui to Molokai on Mokulele Airlines' small commuter plane was beautiful but turbulent. I don't suggest this trip for most tourists.

item.title: I won $28 million in the Powerball when I was 21. One choice saved me from becoming a broke lottery winner.
item.description: Tim Schultz won the Powerball in 1999 as a 21-year-old gas station attendant. Here's what he thinks lottery winners should do — and his one regret.

item.title: Sitting out the $1.7 billion Powerball? Let these stats about just how unlikely winning is comfort you
item.description: The chances of winning the Powerball Grand Prize is much smaller than being struck by lightening, killed in a shark attack, or born on a Leap Day.

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein's wills listed former bank CEOs and other Wall Street figures as possible estate executors
item.description: Jeffrey Epstein's wills named figures like Larry Summers and Jes Staley as possible executors, DOJ files show.

item.title: Judge rejects bid to overturn Trump's $100,000 H-1B visa application fee
item.description: A judge ruled that the Trump administration has the authority to add a $100,000 fee on new H-1B visa applications.

item.title: I quit my job at 29 and traveled solo. I didn't tell my parents until I'd finished my business plan.
item.description: Cassi Zheng spent her 30th birthday alone in Tokyo. It gave her a chance to stop focusing on what was missing.

item.title: Waymo explains why its robotaxis clogged San Francisco streets during a power outage
item.description: Waymo says the San Francisco power outage overwhelmed its robotaxis at scale, creating a backlog that led to response delays.

item.title: Ukraine explains how it used a drone with an airburst warhead to set up its bold strike on a Russian submarine
item.description: The SBU said that it used the drone to strike a Russian Sea Dragon maritime recon aircraft, a key step for its later attack on the submarine.

item.title: Kate Winslet says turning 50 changed how she defines success
item.description: "I think that women get more interesting as we grow older," Kate Winslet said.
